svg.aria-label: Waterfall of one 841 ms transfer: gateway 840.8 ms; transfers-svc insert 37.3 ms, fraud check 29.4 ms, ledger call 740.9 ms; inside it ledger-svc waits 441.1 ms in pool.acquire and 247.0 ms on the row lock, then commits in 25.3 ms; transfers-svc commits in 18.8 ms.
